correctness.rationale: The pinned RESULT.md classifies each generating strict-order strong Morse gradient of K_{2,n} by the earlier hub. The actual full complex is the union of disjoint contractible D_a and D_b plus exactly 3n transverse one-simplices, no cross-dimensional simplices. Collapsing both contractible CW subcomplexes gives a two-vertex graph with 3n parallel edges and H_1=ker(Z^{3n}->Z), rank 3n-1. The S_n action permutes labels; hub exchange swaps the pieces and acts on oriented edge types by e_1->-e_2, e_2->-e_1, e_3->-e_3, yielding characters 3f-1 and 1-f. Checked the equivariant quotient calculation and the invariant rank-one lattice. Independent complete enumeration of vertex-order gradients and all downward faces at n=3,4,5 matches predicted facets. The universal quantifier rests on the symbolic classification, not those finite cases.
